# dsp-moonshine: Moonshine tiny speech-to-text on DSP 25 (plan 006). Standalone (no C2C link).
# Build (Spike):  make build CHIP=dsp25 PLATFORM=SIMS TARGET=dsp-moonshine LINKER=llm EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS="-DMOONSHINE_USE_RVV=ON"
# Build (mic):    make build CHIP=dsp25 PLATFORM=CHIP TARGET=dsp-moonshine LINKER=llm EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS="-DMOONSHINE_USE_RVV=ON -DDSP_MOONSHINE_USE_MIC=ON"
# Weights/audio regenerated by dsp25-tests/moonshine-test/scripts/{export_moonshine,dump_moonshine_reference}.py.

# Split matmul + conv across 2 harts. Requires MOONSHINE_USE_RVV. hart 1 is driven by the proven
# thread-lib/hthread runtime (it owns __main); moonshine adds a watchdogged AMO join on top.
option(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE "Split matmul/conv across 2 harts (requires RVV)" OFF)

add_executable(dsp-moonshine
  src/main.c
  src/moonshine.c
  src/moonshine_rvv.S
  src/model_data.S
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bmark-lib/simple_setup.c   # init_test / PLL setup (used by the mic mode)
)
# NOTE: thread-lib/hthread.c is deliberately NOT linked. moonshine.c supplies its own __main (the
# hart-1 dispatcher); hthread's work-stealing runtime also defines __main, and hart 1 never picked a
# task up under it — reproducibly, on Spike -p2 as well as on silicon. See moonshine.c.

if(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE)
  target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_DUALCORE=1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_DUALCORE=1 (2-hart matmul/conv, moonshine SPSC dispatcher)")
endif()

# Dual-core wedge localization: hart-1 progress beacon + a bounded-wait watchdog on hart 0 that prints
# WHICH fork wedged and the go/done/stage handshake state instead of hanging silently. Also makes the
# FROM_AUDIO run mode loop the identical inference forever (deterministic intermittent-wedge repro).
option(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_DEBUG "Instrument the dual-core handshake to localize wedges" OFF)
if(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_DEBUG)
  target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_DUALCORE_DEBUG=1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_DEBUG=1 (beacon + watchdog + FROM_AUDIO loop)")
endif()

# Fork the conv stem across harts too (default ON). OFF = conv single-core, matmul still dual-core —
# isolates the conv1-on-hart-1 wedge and captures most of the dual-core win (matmul dominates).
option(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_CONV "Also split the conv stem across harts (OFF = conv single-core)" ON)
set(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_CONV_VALUE 1)
if(NOT MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_CONV)
  set(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_CONV_VALUE 0)
  message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_CONV=0 (conv single-core; matmul dual-core)")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_DUALCORE_CONV=${MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_CONV_VALUE})

# Share of each offloaded matmul/conv given to hart 1, in percent. THE RAMP KNOB: raise it as
# dual-core proves stable on silicon. 0 = fork with an EMPTY hart-1 block (control plane only, zero
# hart-1 compute) — the clean way to separate a fork/join wedge from a hart-1-compute wedge.
set(MOONSHINE_H1_PCT 25 CACHE STRING "Percent of each offloaded matmul/conv computed by hart 1 (0..100)")
target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_H1_PCT=${MOONSHINE_H1_PCT})
message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_H1_PCT=${MOONSHINE_H1_PCT}")

# Probe hart 1 at startup with escalating REAL RVV matmuls (reduction + tiled, up to encoder-sized)
# and verify each against hart 0. Costs ~2.5 MB heap and a couple of seconds, and tells you straight
# away whether hart 1 can sustain the RVV kernels at all. ON by default while dual-core is unproven.
# Force-eviction cache flush around every fork/join (hart 1 after writing its block, hart 0 before
# reading it). Needed only if the two harts' L1s are not coherent for plain data — silicon evidence
# says they may not be (the AMO handshake works, but hart 1's matmul output reads back as hart 0's
# pre-write value, non-deterministically). EXPENSIVE: a 256 KB buffer walk per fork. Turn ON to test
# the hypothesis / restore correctness, then measure whether it still beats single-core.
option(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_FLUSH "Force-evict caches around each fork/join (cross-hart coherence)" OFF)
set(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_FLUSH_VALUE 0)
if(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_FLUSH)
  set(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_FLUSH_VALUE 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_FLUSH=1 (cache walk per fork/join)")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_DC_FLUSH=${MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_FLUSH_VALUE})
# Flush walk geometry. 256 KB x 2 passes costs ~40 M cycles/fork on silicon; shrink to find the
# smallest walk that still restores correctness (try 32/64 KB and 1 pass before giving up on it).
set(MOONSHINE_EVICT_KB 256 CACHE STRING "Force-eviction walk size in KB (per hart)")
set(MOONSHINE_EVICT_PASSES 2 CACHE STRING "Force-eviction walk passes")
target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE
  MS_DC_EVICT_BYTES=${MOONSHINE_EVICT_KB}u*1024u
  MS_DC_EVICT_PASSES=${MOONSHINE_EVICT_PASSES}u)

# Run the real workload's dual-core forks with the SCALAR block on both harts (no RVV/tiled/int4).
# The bottom rung of the ladder applied in situ: slow, but it isolates the dispatch mechanism from
# the vector kernels. Use to prove dual-core end-to-end before layering RVV back on.
option(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_SCALAR "Dual-core the workload with scalar matmul blocks only" OFF)
set(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_SCALAR_VALUE 0)
if(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_SCALAR)
  set(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_SCALAR_VALUE 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_SCALAR=1 (scalar dual-core workload)")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_DC_SCALAR=${MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_SCALAR_VALUE})

option(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_SELFTEST "Verify hart-1 RVV with escalating probe matmuls at startup" ON)
set(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_SELFTEST_VALUE 1)
if(NOT MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_SELFTEST)
  set(MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_SELFTEST_VALUE 0)
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_DC_SELFTEST=${MOONSHINE_DUALCORE_SELFTEST_VALUE})

# .incbin in model_data.S resolves paths relative to the demo dir (the model/ subdir holds the
# ~35 MB Q8_0 weights + golden audio, generated by the moonshine-test scripts).
set_source_files_properties(src/model_data.S PROPERTIES
  COMPILE_OPTIONS "-I${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
  OBJECT_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/model/moonshine_tiny_q80.bin;${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/model/moonshine_audio.bin"
)

# The engine malloc()s a few MiB of activation + KV-cache buffers. The linker default heap is only
# 1 MiB (malloc would return NULL -> a fault that spins the trap handler). 16 MiB is safe headroom;
# keep it modest because uart_tsi zero-fills + uploads the whole segment MemSiz over UART.
target_link_options(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE
  -Wl,--defsym=__heap_size=0x2000000       # 32 MiB: ~7 MB K-major encoder transposes + activation/KV
                                           # buffers, plus (MOONSHINE_INT4) ~8 MB of int4 repacks for
                                           # the classifier + decoder fc1. Silent OOM on this target
                                           # just spins the trap handler, so keep generous headroom.
  -Wl,--defsym=__stack_size=0x10000        # 64 KiB
)

# Vectorize the hot matvec kernel with RISC-V V (VLEN=256). OFF = scalar reference oracle.
option(MOONSHINE_USE_RVV "Use RVV-vectorized matvec_q8" OFF)
set(MOONSHINE_USE_RVV_VALUE 0)
if(MOONSHINE_USE_RVV)
  set(MOONSHINE_USE_RVV_VALUE 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_USE_RVV=1 (RVV matvec)")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_USE_RVV=${MOONSHINE_USE_RVV_VALUE})

# --- Bandwidth-bound classifier / decoder-fc1 optimizations (ports of the proven whisper.c ones).
# int4 and DMA both attack the big single-row reduction matmuls; they are mutually exclusive.

# int4 weights: repack Q8_0 -> int4 for reduction matmuls with out >= MS_INT4_MIN_OUT (classifier +
# decoder fc1). Halves that weight DRAM stream. Lossy — validate tokens on Spike. Needs RVV.
option(MOONSHINE_INT4 "int4 weights for the classifier + decoder fc1 (halves their DRAM stream)" OFF)
if(MOONSHINE_INT4)
  target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_INT4=1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_INT4=1 (int4 classifier/fc1)")
endif()

# DMA classifier: double-buffer the classifier weights DRAM->SRAM (lossless int8). Silicon-only
# (Spike has no DMA engine). Mutually exclusive with MOONSHINE_INT4.
option(MOONSHINE_DMA_CLASSIFIER "DMA double-buffer the classifier weights through SRAM (silicon only)" OFF)
if(MOONSHINE_DMA_CLASSIFIER)
  target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_DMA_CLASSIFIER=1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_DMA_CLASSIFIER=1 (SRAM double-buffered classifier)")
endif()

# Vocab pruning: score only the first N token ids in the classifier (0 = full vocab). Cuts the
# classifier stream ~vocab/N x; SentencePiece id-ordering risk, so it is experimental.
set(MOONSHINE_VOCAB_TOPK 0 CACHE STRING "Classifier vocab pruning: score first N ids (0 = full vocab)")
if(NOT MOONSHINE_VOCAB_TOPK EQUAL 0)
  target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_VOCAB_TOPK=${MOONSHINE_VOCAB_TOPK})
  message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_VOCAB_TOPK=${MOONSHINE_VOCAB_TOPK}")
endif()

# Coarse per-kernel cycle profiling (rdcycle around matmul/attn/conv/gelu/norm/rope).
option(MOONSHINE_PROFILE "Per-kernel cycle profiling" OFF)
set(MOONSHINE_PROFILE_VALUE 0)
if(MOONSHINE_PROFILE)
  set(MOONSHINE_PROFILE_VALUE 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_PROFILE=1")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_PROFILE=${MOONSHINE_PROFILE_VALUE})

# Run modes. Default = transcribe the embedded audio blob and validate against the golden.
option(DSP_MOONSHINE_FROM_AUDIO "Transcribe the embedded audio blob (no compare)" OFF)
option(DSP_MOONSHINE_USE_MIC "Capture + transcribe live I2S mic audio (CHIP only)" OFF)
set(DSP_MOONSHINE_FROM_AUDIO_VALUE 0)
set(DSP_MOONSHINE_USE_MIC_VALUE 0)
if(DSP_MOONSHINE_FROM_AUDIO)
  set(DSP_MOONSHINE_FROM_AUDIO_VALUE 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: DSP_MOONSHINE_FROM_AUDIO=1")
endif()
if(DSP_MOONSHINE_USE_MIC)
  set(DSP_MOONSHINE_USE_MIC_VALUE 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: DSP_MOONSHINE_USE_MIC=1 (live I2S mic)")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE
  DSP_MOONSHINE_FROM_AUDIO=${DSP_MOONSHINE_FROM_AUDIO_VALUE}
  DSP_MOONSHINE_USE_MIC=${DSP_MOONSHINE_USE_MIC_VALUE}
)

# Row threshold for the register-tiled GEMM. Set above the max row count (e.g. 9999) to DISABLE
# tiling entirely, so every matmul goes through the hand-written asm kernel ms_matrow_q8 instead.
#
# Why that might be faster despite less weight reuse: the intrinsics kernels walk i8->i16->i32->f32,
# so GCC must emit a vsetvli at every SEW change. Measured at -O3: gemm_tiled_block changes vtype
# once per 3.4 vector instructions and gemm_int4_row once per 2.2, while ms_matrow_q8 holds a single
# e32,m4 vtype across its whole inner loop. A vtype change drains the vector pipeline, and on this
# silicon int4 (2.2) is much slower than int8 (asm) even though it streams half the bytes — so the
# codegen cost dominates the bandwidth saving. Tiling is the same trade, so measure it.
# NOTE: this is the THRESHOLD for using the tiled path (n >= MS_TILE_MR), not the register unroll —
# gemm_tiled_block unrolls 4 rows unconditionally. Set above the max row count to disable tiling.
set(MOONSHINE_TILE_MR 4 CACHE STRING "Row threshold for the tiled GEMM; >max rows disables tiling")

# Data cache size, used to block the tiled GEMM output columns so one K-major weight slice stays
# resident across all row tiles (weights streamed once per matmul instead of ceil(nrows/4) times).
set(MOONSHINE_CACHE_KB 256 CACHE STRING "Data cache size in KB, for GEMM cache blocking")
target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_CACHE_BYTES=${MOONSHINE_CACHE_KB}u*1024u)
message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_CACHE_KB=${MOONSHINE_CACHE_KB}")
target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_TILE_MR=${MOONSHINE_TILE_MR})
message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_TILE_MR=${MOONSHINE_TILE_MR}")

# Hardware roofline probe: times the real matvec kernel L1-resident (compute limit) and streaming a
# multi-MB cold matrix (memory limit), then prints cycles/MAC for each. Use to decide whether the
# remaining gap is bytes or the vector unit itself. Adds ~5 MB heap and a second at startup.
option(MOONSHINE_ROOFLINE "Print the compute/memory roofline at startup" OFF)
set(MOONSHINE_ROOFLINE_VALUE 0)
if(MOONSHINE_ROOFLINE)
  set(MOONSHINE_ROOFLINE_VALUE 1)
  message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_ROOFLINE=1")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE MS_ROOFLINE=${MOONSHINE_ROOFLINE_VALUE})

# Optimization level. The top-level CMakeLists does a global add_compile_options(-O1), which lands
# AFTER Release's -O3 on the command line, so the whole project builds at -O1 (last -O wins). Every
# hot kernel here except ms_matrow_q8 is RVV INTRINSICS (gemm_tiled_mr4/mr1, gemm_int4_row,
# conv1d_valid_rvv), and at -O1 GCC spills vector registers and hoists nothing — measured ~51
# cycles/MAC on silicon against a <1 cycles/MAC roofline. Target options come after directory options,
# so this wins. Set MOONSHINE_OPT=-O1 to reproduce the old behaviour.
set(MOONSHINE_OPT "-O3" CACHE STRING "Optimization level for dsp-moonshine (overrides the global -O1)")
target_compile_options(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE ${MOONSHINE_OPT})
message(STATUS "dsp-moonshine: MOONSHINE_OPT=${MOONSHINE_OPT}")

target_include_directories(dsp-moonshine PUBLIC include)
target_include_directories(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bmark-lib)

# glossy (whole-archive) provides the dsp25 HAL (UART etc.); m provides erff/tanhf/cosf/sinf/expf/powf.
target_link_libraries(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE
  -L${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/glossy -Wl,--whole-archive glossy -Wl,--no-whole-archive
  m
)

if(PROF_COV)
  target_link_libraries(dsp-moonshine PRIVATE gcov)
endif()
